gaps.explanation: The General Fund budget-and-actual schedule (p8) prints 'Grants and donations' 28,296 among RECEIPTS (printed Total receipts 3,808,656, which also includes Bond proceeds 502,350, recorded in detail as other financing), while the cash-basis governmental funds statement (p4) prints Grants and donations 28,296 under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES, outside Total receipts (General 3,278,010; Total 3,459,046 printed). The JSON statement keeps that receipt line outside_printed_total, so the statement total compared is 3,459,044 (the p4 receipt rows; printed 3,459,046, report rounding 2). Schedule 3,487,340 - 28,296 = 3,459,044. The detail line (Budget and Actual - General Fund, 'Grants and donations' 28,296, p8) is a printed schedule line and is kept. Inside the General Fund the schedule's Other miscellaneous 44,960 vs statement 43,969 (+991) is offset by its Intergovernmental lines 325,479 vs statement 326,470 (-991; Library state aid 991, p11). No fix.

Statement (accrual, p6 Total column): total operating revenues 1,255,683 + interest income 26,603 + unrealized gain/loss 3,496 = 1,285,782. Detail is the budgetary-basis proprietary schedule (p10): Total revenues actual 1,291,862 printed (utility sales 1,261,763 + interest 30,099; detail lines 1,291,861). Utility sales 1,261,763 = operating revenues 1,255,683 + decrease in accounts receivable 6,080 (cash flows p7); interest 30,099 = 26,603 + 3,496. The gap 6,079 is the accrual receivable change (plus report rounding 1). No fix.

Statement (accrual, p6 Total column): total operating expenses 789,570 (incl. depreciation 228,404) + interest expense 26,855 = 816,425. Detail is the budgetary-basis proprietary schedule (p10): Total expenditures actual 765,366 printed (Operating 554,691 + Capital improvements 652,169 + Debt service (441,495), Water debt service (472,238) netting loan proceeds; detail lines 765,367). The printed totals really differ (51,058). No fix.
